name: usage-bar
description: A usage bar above the prompt: context fill, 5h/7d quota and cost, with optional git, model and prompt cache segments per environment

terminalDisplay.title: Terminal: show the bar
terminalDisplay.description: Draws the bar above the prompt in the terminal.

terminalGit.title: Terminal: show git
terminalGit.description: Adds the repository, branch and working tree state. Needs the terminal bar on.

terminalCache.title: Terminal: show the cache countdown
terminalCache.description: Adds the minutes until the prompt cache expires. Needs the terminal bar on.

terminalModel.title: Terminal: show the model
terminalModel.description: Adds the model and effort level. Needs the terminal bar on.

vscodeDisplay.title: VS Code: show the bar
vscodeDisplay.description: Draws the bar above the prompt in VS Code.

vscodeGit.title: VS Code: show git
vscodeGit.description: Adds the repository, branch and working tree state. Needs the VS Code bar on.

vscodeCache.title: VS Code: show the cache countdown
vscodeCache.description: Adds the minutes until the prompt cache expires. Needs the VS Code bar on.

vscodeModel.title: VS Code: show the model
vscodeModel.description: Adds the model and effort level. Needs the VS Code bar on.
